name: agentic-workflow
description: Deterministic GitHub Copilot workflow repository for skills, agents, prompts, instructions, hooks, and MCP tooling.

scripts.docker:test:workspace:stability: docker run --rm agentic-workflow:latest bash -lc "npm run test:workspace:stability"
scripts.test:workspace:stability: bash health.sh && npx --no-install ahk sync --direction in && npx --no-install ahk status && uv run python -m unittest tests.test_ahk_integration tests.test_atomic_index_fts
